import numpy as np, pandas as pd
from alphacrafter.sim.utils import get_index_daily_data, get_stock_daily_data
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
frames={}
for s in U:
    d=get_index_daily_data(s,3000)
    if d is None or len(d)==0: d=get_stock_daily_data(s,3000)
    if d is not None:
        d=d.copy(); d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date']).dt.normalize(); frames[s]=d.set_index('date')
# candidate: volume surprise, signed by recent price direction, with only completed bars
# volume surprise is log(volume / trailing 20d median); multiply by 5d return direction
rows=[]
for s,d in frames.items():
    if 'volume' not in d or 'close' not in d: continue
    close=pd.to_numeric(d.close,errors='coerce'); vol=pd.to_numeric(d.volume,errors='coerce')
    r=close.pct_change(); vs=np.log(vol.replace(0,np.nan)/vol.rolling(20,min_periods=15).median())
    f=vs * np.sign(r.rolling(5,min_periods=5).sum())
    z=pd.DataFrame({'f':f,'fr':r.shift(-1)}).loc[:'2026-07-15']; z['s']=s; rows.append(z.reset_index())
x=pd.concat(rows,ignore_index=True).dropna(subset=['f','fr'])
ics=x.groupby('date').apply(lambda q: q['f'].corr(q['fr']) if len(q)>=8 else np.nan).dropna()
# 5d forward compounded
for s,d in frames.items():
    pass
# calculate horizon by merging returns per asset
x['fr5']=np.nan; x['fr10']=np.nan
for s in x.s.unique():
    ix=x.s==s; d=frames[s]; c=pd.to_numeric(d.close,errors='coerce');
    x.loc[ix,'fr5']=x.loc[ix,'date'].map(c.shift(-5)/c-1)
    x.loc[ix,'fr10']=x.loc[ix,'date'].map(c.shift(-10)/c-1)
for col in ['fr5','fr10']:
    q=x.dropna(subset=['f',col]); a=q.groupby('date').apply(lambda z:z.f.corr(z[col]) if len(z)>=8 else np.nan).dropna(); print(col,len(a),a.mean(),a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1), (a>0).mean())
print('daily',len(ics),ics.mean(),ics.mean()/ics.std(ddof=1),(ics>0).mean(),'meanN',x.groupby('date').size().mean(),'coverage',len(x)/(len(frames)*len(pd.date_range('2020-01-01','2026-07-15'))))
print('regimes',x.assign(y=x.date.dt.year).groupby('y').apply(lambda q:q.groupby('date').apply(lambda z:z.f.corr(z.fr) if len(z)>=8 else np.nan).mean()).to_dict())
# rank turnover
r=x.assign(rank=x.groupby('date').f.rank(pct=True)).sort_values(['s','date']); print('turnover',r.groupby('s').rank.diff().abs().mean())
# pooled corr with existing-ish common signals
print('dates',x.date.min(),x.date.max(),'names',x.s.nunique())
